description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy scores of three different sentiment analysis tools—TEXTBLOB, VADER, and ChatGPT—applied to two datasets: “Emoji Tweets” and “Overall Tweets.” The horizontal axis represents the categories, labeled “Emoji Tweets” and “Overall Tweet,” in that order, and is a categorical scale. The vertical axis represents “Accuracy,” with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. For “Emoji Tweets,” the TEXTBLOB tool is represented by a white bar with an approximate height of 0.32, VADER is represented by a diagonally-patterned bar with an approximate height of 0.48, and ChatGPT is represented by a solid green bar with an approximate height of 0.66. For “Overall Tweet,” TEXTBLOB is represented by a white bar with an approximate height of 0.44, VADER is represented by a diagonally-patterned bar with an approximate height of 0.52, and ChatGPT is represented by a solid green bar with an approximate height of 0.64. The bars are grouped by category, with each tool represented by a different colored bar within each group. No bars are visually emphasized, and the categories are not sorted in any apparent order.
